fields.description: Delphine Beach Residences is a beachfront apartment collection on Sobha Siniya Island, connected to mainland Umm Al Quwain. The plans offer one- to three-bedroom layouts with balconies, yards or terraces according to type. Tower C is identified as fully furnished in the reviewed brochure; other towers and units should be checked individually.

overview: The three-bedroom Type A has a large terrace relative to its enclosed suite. Its total saleable area therefore overstates indoor space if the two components are not considered separately. Other layouts use smaller balconies or ground-level yards.
research.locationNote: Sobha Siniya Island, Umm Al Quwain. Island golf, marina and leisure facilities are wider master-community amenities; their access and opening arrangements need confirmation.
research.priceNote: The own developer page fetched on 31 October 2026 advertises AED 1,600,000 from, subject to inventory availability. This is a published guide, not a checked available unit, valuation or binding offer. Other historical launch advertisements may use a different price or unit mix.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder publishes 20% at launch, 40% construction and 40% handover. Its two options repeat the overall split, with one specifying four construction instalments. No original current payment sheet was accessible.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder reports December 2027. The reviewed brochure does not provide a current unit-specific completion guarantee; confirm tower and contract.
